Year 1 · four months of classes · ahead of schedule

664 people finished all 8 hours — 28% of the 2,400 goal.

CEDA is aiming to finish by February 2027, 15 months before CPUC's June 2028 deadline. Classes started May 1. Here's how CEDA's 16 community areas compare with every digital literacy project CASF has funded since 2018 (578 projects, from CPUC's 2025 annual report). Completions per month

Stockton and Calaveras report every month. Sacramento reports one May–August total, shown on the right. All 664 completions are here.

Path to 2,400

We're on our way: 664 done by 8/31/2026, with a plan to finish all 2,400 by February 2027. The dashed line is an estimate that simply extends today's average pace. At today's pace the program passes 2,400 completions by summer 2027, still about 10 months before CPUC's June 2028 deadline.

    About this data

    Sources and dates

    Funding

    CEDA is a program of the CalAsian Chamber of Commerce, funded in part by the Broadband Adoption Account of the California Advanced Services Fund (CASF), administered by the California Public Utilities Commission.

    Broadband sign-up commitments

    Broadband sign-up commitments come from three questions in the SparkEd (Techedify) course: at enrollment, whether the participant intends to sign up for home internet; at completion, whether they are likely to sign up; and at completion, whether they would like help signing up. Each participant is counted once, even if they answered yes to more than one.

    Program data

    CEDA Year 1 program reports, covering 4/26/2026–8/31/2026.

    CASF comparison

    CPUC 2025 CASF Annual Report, Attachments D and E, with project data as of 12/31/2025. CEDA is 4 months into classes; completed projects are measured over their full grant term.

    Qualification

    From each area's preference checklist in CEDA's Adoption Account application.

    About the map

    County lines are U.S. Census outlines. Terrain, rivers and forests show California's general landforms. Pins mark approximate neighborhood locations.
